sensor_calibration_audit.classification_limit: FIRMS types and thermal patterns do not establish wildfire, agricultural burning, or industrial cause.

findings.detail: Sep 2026 recorded 79.0 HHE, exceeding the 2001–2020 95th percentile (46.3) with Z_robust = +12.51 (reference median 24.3). This is a descriptive demo threshold.
Nighttime share of activity with known day/night labels reached 54.3% during Sep 2026. Satellite detections alone do not establish crown fire or fire cause.

phenology.definition: shortest cyclic window containing 90% of baseline activity

calendar.coverage_note: Recorded detections do not establish complete observation coverage or absence of fire.

verification_scope: Unsigned reproducibility and internal evidence consistency; not source authentication.

passes.note: Approximate modeled opportunities from nominal solar times, schematic ground-track phase and spherical viewing geometry. No ephemerides, cloud screening, actual instrument scheduling or operational accuracy are supplied. Day/night labels are nominal branches, not computed local illumination. Historical 50-minute NOAA-21/20 spacing is schematic; known source end dates are applied.
